steps.name: preflight-and-release-audit
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; echo BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); echo DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse origin/develop); echo MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main); test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "e4a8f31288eb7f000643cecdd6c5351510a89ce6"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo '=== release commit ==='; git show --stat --oneline --summary fea101e53d38e9a964485ff31c394226afd51831; echo '=== release/version metadata diff ==='; git diff origin/develop origin/main -- platformio.ini interface/package.json interface/package-lock.json github.md AGENTS.md

steps.name: sync-release-baseline-and-document-policy
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json

p = Path('platformio.ini')
s = p.read_text()
old = '-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.0\\"'
new = '-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.1\\"'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected APP_VERSION 1.0.0 not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))

for name in ['interface/package.json', 'interface/package-lock.json']:
    p = Path(name)
    data = json.loads(p.read_text())
    if name.endswith('package.json'):
        if data.get('version') != '1.0.0':
            raise SystemExit(f'{name}: expected version 1.0.0, got {data.get("version")}')
        data['version'] = '1.0.1'
    else:
        if data.get('version') == '1.0.0':
            data['version'] = '1.0.1'
        root = data.get('packages', {}).get('')
        if isinstance(root, dict) and root.get('version') == '1.0.0':
            root['version'] = '1.0.1'
    p.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent='\t') + '\n')

p = Path('github.md')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '- Nie nadpisuj ani nie cofaj lokalnych zmian uzytkownika bez wyraznej prosby.\n'
addition = '''- Nie merguj `main` z powrotem do `develop` tylko po to, aby zsynchronizowac snapshot wydania.\n- Po wydaniu zsynchronizuj do `develop` tylko metadane bazowej wersji (np. `APP_VERSION` i wersje pakietu), jesli release podbil je wylacznie na `main`.\n- Rozbieznosc historii `main` i `develop` jest oczekiwana w tym modelu: `main` przechowuje snapshoty wydan, a `develop` szczegolowa historie rozwoju.\n'''
if addition.strip() not in s:
    if anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit('github.md policy anchor not found')
    s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + addition, 1)
    p.write_text(s)

p = Path('AGENTS.md')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '- Set `work_branch` explicitly. Follow MatrixHub Git policy: normal development is on `develop`; `main` is the stable release line unless the user explicitly requests another branch.\n'
addition = '- For release snapshots and post-release branch synchronization, follow `github.md`; do not merge `main` back into `develop` merely to import a release snapshot.\n'
if addition not in s:
    if anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit('AGENTS.md branch-policy anchor not found')
    s = s.replace(anchor, anchor + addition, 1)
    p.write_text(s)
PY

echo '=== changed files ==='; git status --short; echo '=== diff ==='; git diff --check; git diff -- platformio.ini interface/package.json interface/package-lock.json github.md AGENTS.md

steps.name: verify
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; $HOME/.platformio/penv/bin/pio test -e native; cd interface; npm run quality:frontend:fast

steps.name: commit-and-publish-develop
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git diff --check; git status --short; git add platformio.ini interface/package.json interface/package-lock.json github.md AGENTS.md; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Sync develop with 1.0.1 release baseline'; git fetch origin develop; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "e4a8f31288eb7f000643cecdd6c5351510a89ce6"; git push origin HEAD:develop; echo NEW_DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
